title: OTel: Building Domain-Specialized Telecom LLM Foundations for Intelligent Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.15436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier AI models have advanced rapidly, but they still struggle with telecom-specific tasks. We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource with derived datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, plus 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines across embedding, reranking, and language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times, and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.5% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.952 MRR@

translated_title: OTel：构建面向智能网络的领域专用电信大语言模型基础
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15436v1 公告类型：新 摘要：前沿AI模型发展迅速，但在电信特定任务上仍显不足。我们提出Open Telco（OTel），一个开放电信AI资源，包含用于检索、重排序、指令微调及安全/弃权判断的衍生数据集，以及30个覆盖嵌入、重排序和语言模型的全面参数后训练基线。社区已对该资源进行了大量参与：截至2026年5月3日，发布模型下载量超过1600万次，项目获得全球157+篇媒体报道。基于先前的开放电信数据集和基准，OTel在统一资源中提供了文档化的电信数据源、保留评估分区、训练好的嵌入模型、重排序器、基于上下文的LLM以及安全/弃权数据。OTel的后训练提升了所有三类模型的性能：嵌入检索达到93.5% NDCG@10，重排序达到0.952 MRR@
tldr: OTel提供了一个统一的开放电信AI资源，通过后训练显著提升了嵌入、重排序和语言模型在电信任务上的性能，并获得了广泛的社区采用。
en_tdlr: OTel provides a unified open telecom AI resource, significantly improving embedding, reranking, and language model performance on telecom tasks through post-training, with broad community adoption.
